T: Did we just become best friends. Yep.
D: Two middle-aged men who still live at home become stepbrothers when their parents marry.
P: Serve the wine when the Catalina Wine Mixer starts.
S: Prawn on cucumber, honey ricotta toasts, figs wrapped in prosciutto
Prawns on cucumber rounds with lemon mayo, crostini with whipped ricotta and honey, and figs wrapped in prosciutto, on silver trays.
Bunk bed parmesan garlic butter popcorn
Stovetop popcorn tossed in garlic butter and parmesan

Fresh stovetop popcorn tossed with garlic butter, finely grated parmesan, cracked pepper and chopped parsley, split into two big bowls for top and bottom bunk. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pot with a lid, add 150g popping corn, cover and shake over medium heat until the popping slows. Melt 60g butter with a crushed garlic clove. Toss the popcorn with the garlic butter, 40g finely grated parmesan, cracked pepper, fine salt and chopped parsley. Split between two big bowls.
the big pitch for their entertainment company

Little chuck patties smashed thin and crisp on a hot griddle, cheddar melted on, with buttery onions, pickles and burger sauce in soft slider rolls. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 20 minutes. Roll 600g chuck mince into 12 balls. Mix 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Heat a griddle until smoking, smash the balls thin, season and cook 90 seconds, flip and add a piece of cheddar. Fill 12 toasted slider rolls with patty, onions, pickles and sauce.
M: Snapper roasted with lemon, garlic and capers, herb buttered new potatoes

Snapper fillets roasted with lemon, garlic, capers and olive oil, with herbed buttery new potatoes and a green salad in mustard dressing. Boil 800g new potatoes for 15 minutes and toss with 30g butter and chopped parsley and dill. Lay 4 snapper fillets in a dish with lemon slices, 2 sliced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp capers and 3 tbsp olive oil. Roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Whisk 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tbsp white wine vinegar and 3 tbsp olive oil and toss with a bag of mixed leaves.
the awkward first dinner as a blended family

Beef and pork meatloaf with grated onion and milk-soaked crumbs, glazed sticky with tomato and brown sugar, with buttery mash and green beans. Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk. Mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, a grated onion, 1 egg, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and salt. Press into a loaf tin. Mix 80ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and spread on top. Bake at 180C for 1 hour and rest 10 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Steam 300g green beans and toss with butter.
W: Vanilla and chocolate ice cream with hot fudge, whipped cream, sprinkles, cherries
Vanilla and chocolate ice cream in a big tub on ice, with hot fudge made from dark chocolate melted into cream, sprinkles, whipped cream and cherries so everyone builds their own.
K: Catalina Wine Mixer strawberry rosé spritz
Dry rosé over pressed strawberries and elderflower, topped up and served over ice

Chilled dry rosé with muddled strawberries, elderflower cordial and lemon, topped with soda water over ice in big wine glasses. Slice 8 strawberries and divide between four large wine glasses. Add 15ml elderflower cordial and a squeeze of lemon to each and press lightly with a spoon. Fill with ice, pour in 120ml cold dry rosé and top with 60ml soda water. Stir gently and add a lemon wheel.

steps.text: Score the eggplant flesh, brush with 4 tbsp of the oil and the salt and roast cut side up at 220C for 20 minutes.
Top with lemon slices, sliced garlic, capers and 1 tbsp of the oil and roast 10 minutes more.
Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and toss with the butter, parsley and dill.
Whisk the Dijon, vinegar and remaining oil and toss through the leaves.
Crumble the feta over the eggplant and serve with the potatoes and salad.
